Hi Sofia — thanks, jumping in on the technical thread. I’ve attached a first-pass deployment diagram and a vendor questionnaire template we can pre-fill. Key points to note: 

- VPC deployment (cloud-hosted private control plane):
  * Supports private endpoints (no public IPs), customer-managed KMS integration, and VPC peering or private link.
  * Audit logs exported to your logging project (S3/GCS/Azure Blob).
  * We provide options for prefix/KV caching to be disabled for PHI-sensitive workloads.

- On-prem / air-gap option:
  * We offer a packaged appliance image that can be installed on customer hardware. Models can be loaded via encrypted transfer and local KMS/HSM can be used for key storage.
  * Patch process: offline patch bundles signed by Redwood, customer applies maintenance windows; we provide a verification tool to check image signatures.
  * We can disable any outbound telemetry; however, emergency hotfix installs require an approved signed bundle process.

Requested from your team for the technical session: 
1) Network topology diagram for the environment you want to integrate with (we can annotate changes).
2) List of required compliance artifacts (POC owner for HIPAA, and GDPR processor agreements).
3) A short timeslot for your infosec team to walk us through the questionnaire priorities.

Suggested meeting times: Wed May 26 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu May 27 14:00–15:00 PT. Let me know which works and I’ll send a calendar invite with a preparatory doc.

Cheers,

Thanks Daniel — helpful questions. Quick consolidated answers and proposed actions: 

- Zero public egress: Yes for VPC mode. We support private DNS and customer VPC endpoints; outbound package updates are opt-in and can be proxied through customer-controlled update servers. I’ll have a short technical note from our infra team that details DNS and update flows.
- Air-gapped model updates: We support signed offline bundles. We can integrate with your HSM/KMS for key signing or offer an escrow workflow. Evelyn will propose an image verification checklist.
- Audit logs: our audit records are JSON-lines with activity, actor, timestamp, and object-id. Retention is configurable from 30–730 days; immutability snapshots can be pushed to your archival bucket. I’ve attached a sample log extract and the SOC2 Type II report.

• Evelyn: Populate vendor-questionnaire-Medsys.xlsx with detailed architecture answers (ETA: 3 business days).
